name: forms-benchmark-e2e
description: Conformance и профилирование страниц forms-benchmark в Chromium (CDP, трассы, рендеры)

scripts.bench:quick: cross-env BENCH_QUICK=1 playwright test --project=bench && node scripts/report.mjs
scripts.bench:frameworks: cross-env BENCH_SUITE=frameworks playwright test --project=bench && cross-env BENCH_SUITE=frameworks node scripts/report.mjs
scripts.bench:frameworks:quick: cross-env BENCH_SUITE=frameworks BENCH_QUICK=1 playwright test --project=bench && cross-env BENCH_SUITE=frameworks node scripts/report.mjs
